summary: E2E test of new CloudIVR SIP sales funnel /cloudivr/sip (desktop 1920, mobile 390, en/fr/es), signed-out signup funnel, signed-in Alice funnel, landing footer regression, SEO node tests, and catalog pytest. Every requested feature works. Found 1 minor UX bug: when you arrive from another page you land at the old scroll position instead of the top.

ui_bugs.issue: If you click the landing footer 'SIP & softphones' (a React Router Link), /cloudivr/sip opens with the previous scroll position (scrollY≈5039), so the user sees the final CTA/footer instead of the hero. Terms.js already has a scroll-to-top on mount; SipFunnel has none. The SIP nav logo going back to /cloudivr likely does the same.

Hero CTAs + nav links (apps/how/plans/faq/See plans) scroll to sections (top at nav offset 64px); logo href /cloudivr
Apps section 4 cards, connection card server/port/username, browser note; Copy -> 'Server copied' toast, clipboard = sip.cloudivr.net

Plans live prices $50/$75/$120, allowances, sip data-included false/true/true, voicemail/aiAgent ticks correct, extra 3/15/30, 'Best for SIP' only on Pro, compare table expands (24 rows) with highlighted sip row
FAQ 9 items, q0/q1 correct answers; final CTA Choose Pro -> /cloudivr/signup?plan=pro, Compare plans -> #plans
Signed-out: Choose Pro -> signup?plan=pro (chosen plan note) -> new account -> /cloudivr/app/buy?plan=pro with 'Pro plan picked' hint; starter/business hrefs correct
Signed-in Alice: sip-nav-dashboard shown, plan hrefs /cloudivr/app/buy?plan=<id>, Business -> Buy with 'Business plan picked'
Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow, sticky bar shown after scrolling ('Pro · $75/mo', Get started -> signup?plan=pro); hidden on desktop
i18n fr/es: hero, sections, plan cards, compare table, FAQ answers, CTAs and doc title translated; switching back to en works
SEO node tests: sip_page_seo 5/5, seo_2026-09 8/8, domain_guard 18/18
